en: An old black and white photographic postcard featuring five men standing in a row, facing the camera. The men are minimally clothed with fabric wrapped around their waists and some have head coverings or jewelry. The background appears to be a simple woven mat or rural backdrop. A circular stamp or insignia can be seen on the bottom left corner, and a printed number is present in the bottom right corner.
